content:
**Mothman Egg Omelette** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

An omelet made from a Mothman Egg. It gives a 30 minute boost to Charisma while restoring a large amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Mothman Egg (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Mothman Egg | | Mothman Egg Omelette (1) | 

It can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked up a Mothman Egg for the first time.

The spelling used in the game, "omelette," is British English. "Omelet" is the American English spelling. [1]
